main_text.l: be Thimnath, quae à Iosua Daniae tribui ascri-
bitur, sed quae nondum ab ea occupata tem-
pore Samsonis esset: consilio Dei, & consen-
su parentum: quibus non consultis (funt.n.
honorandi) fas non erat liberos matrimo-
nia inire.
Sic parentum consilio vxores duxerunt
Isaac, Gen.24. Ismael, Gen.21. Iacob, Gen.29.
Sichem, Gen.28. Her, Gen.38. Dauid, 1.Reg.18.
Tobias, idq; iussu angeli, Tob.7.8. & hoc loco
Samson, & alij pij homines. Et eam auctori-
tatem, vt ex parentum iudicio & voluntate
liberi vxores ducant, Moses parentibus quoq; t-
ribuit, cum Exod.34. cap. inquit: Nec vxores
de filiabus eorum accipies filijs tuis. Et Paulus
1.Corin.7. Qui matrimonio iungit virginem
suam, bene facit. Apparet quoq; ex Ecclesia-
sticis scriptoribus hunc morem à patrib. re-
ceptum, semper in Ecclesia & populo Dei ob-
seruatum, ne liberi sine parentum consensu
connubia inirent. Sic enim Tertul. lib.2. ad
vxorem scribit: Nā nec in terris, filij sine con-
sensu patrum rite & iure nubent. Et Ambro-
sius citans Euripidis versus in Andromacha,
cum Orestes Hermionis connubium petit,
ostendit hanc rem non ad suum, sed patris ar-
bitrium pertinere. Ad legitimam ergo con-
iunctionem vnius maris & vnius fœminae non
solum necesse est, vt earum personarum con-
iunctio fiat, quae sit nepharia & legibus pro-
hibita (id quod & exemplum Corinthij monet
1. Cor.5.) & vt contractus fiat vtriusque[?]

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the top of the page. Signature "K 2" read from the foot; the final numeral is slightly unclear. Line-end hyphens restored where the printer marked them ("confen-su", "consen-su" joined as printed in the sense). The word "ascribitur" is split across lines without a printed hyphen and is written whole. The last word "vtriufquè" is printed with an accent that may be misread; marked [?]. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The opening fragment "be Thimnath" is printed as a line fragment and is kept as such.
